nom: PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer

avis.titre: My go to day time moisturizer!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this! As a sensitive skin girly, this moistuizer is lightweight and ideal for a daytime moistuzier (i use a heavier moisturizer for nighttime and recommend the same). Havent gotten a single breakout and skin feels moisturized all day. Loce peach and lily

The moisturizer itself is good, light and not sticky. The pump however is terrible. First use the pump seized. After clearing & cleaning, got the pump to freely move again, but as soon as I tried to use it with product it seized again.
I received a free sample size with my other Ulta order, I tried it out, and I fell in love with it. It makes my skin feel really good and hydrated.

I've been using this product for years and it is by far one of my favorites. I have pretty dry skin, lots of acne and irritation and this is so soothing. Helps keep my skin moisturized all day. With a dewy but not greasy look. It really does hydrate so well.

I really enjoy this moisturizer. It is very light and sinks into the skin quickly. I have sensitive and acne-prone skin and this does not irritate it. This is definitely not moisturizing enough for winter months for me, so I had to take off one start rating, but it works great for spring, summer, and fall.
I absolutely love your Glass skin water-gel moisturizer. It's extremely light weight while giving you a natural glow.

I have been using this for over a year and it always makes my skin look and feel better. During the summer when I can get a little sunburnt I have also used it alternating with aloe only, to soothe and heal.

This moisturizer does well for my super sensitive skin. I am 49 and have never found a moisturizer that doesn't cause me to breakout. I can use this sparingly on my face except for chin. My chin still breaks out. But I am hoping that the cleanser is just bringing out impurities. Maybe the moisturizer isn't the cause. I've been using this for about a month. The water based gel is lighter and doesn't feel as heavy or greasy as the non gel formulas that no doubt break me out no matter how lightweight they presume to be.
The moisturizer is fine but I don't like how it makes my skin feels sticky. My skin looks moisturized but it doesn't "feel" like it. It kind of feels like it's sitting on top of my skin.

avis.titre: Suitable replacement for Clinique moisture surge
avis.texte: I switched to P&L from Clinique and have been searching for a moisturizer that isn't too greasy but still does the job and this wins. it can be a little sticky on application but if you work it in, the stickiness doesn't last. if you have sensitive skin it can sting a little on application but no more than a strong toner. my skin stays hydrated and doesn't feel greasy or oily, and a little goes a long way.

This is my favorite day-time moisturizer. My skin is dehydrated, sensitive and prone to breakouts from silicones and oils and this gel is a holy grail for me. The gel texture is lightweight and yet very hydrating. The clean and quality ingredients work perfect for my skin which is smooth and glowing now! Totally glass-skin! I receive a lot of compliments and questions about what moisturizer I use. So now you know my secret !
I enjoy the glow this moisturizer gives my skin, though I have to be careful with how much I use or it's a bit sticky. Overall enjoying it so far.
very moisturizing and smooth wish the bottle held a little more product
This feels so good on my skin! When I'm consistent with using the whole skin care system, there is a definite different in my skin's health, and I look forward to the moisturizer each time.
A little bit goes a long way. Non-irritating, long-lasting moisture.

I was looking for a lightweight moisturizer for mornings and the the summer. This one is perfect. It's lightweight and actually hydrated my skin. It doesn't feel sticky either, which I find is a common issue with gel moisturizers. I would buy this again

avis.titre: Love the product, packaging needs work
avis.texte: I was looking for a gel moisturizer so i decided to try this one. I love this item; however, the shape of the packaging makes it difficult to use all of the product. The high price is hard to justify when the bottle shape means you don't actually get the total ounces you paid for.

This has to be one of the best water-gel moisturizers around. It goes on clear and smooth, has no strong odor and doesn't feel heavy. Have used it in place of a primer but have found it does work better if it's applied after the P&L Glass Refining Serum. While it is hydrating, would recommend using a thicker cream (like the Matcha Cream of the same brand) for more dry skin and applying it in the evening. Side Note: Using the P&L Wild Dew Treatment Essence w/the serum & moisturizer prior to makeup application caused foundation to crack but without the essence the foundation lasted all day. Works best alongside the other P&L products. Haven't had best of luck using this product in combination with products from other brands.

avis.titre: Great Lightweight Moisturizer, But Pills Under Makeup
avis.texte: I'm a huge fan of the OG Glass Skin Serum, so when my typical winter moisturizer started feeling too heavy, I thought I'd try out another product in the Glass Skin line.Bottom line, it works well! However, it does slightly pill under makeup. At least it does on my sensitive, oily-prone skin. I suggest waiting in between application and putting on foundation, or just using this at night.

I was worried it wouldn't be hydrating enough and I would need a thicker moisturizer that was cream based, but I use this morning and night and it's amazing! My skin feels super hydrated. Sometimes I mix it with my sunscreen to make my sunscreen have less of a white cast.

avis.titre: Loving my skin on my face!
avis.texte: Together with the Glass Skin Serum the Glass Skin Water Gel Moisturizer works great!! I love how hydrated my skin feels, not to mention how it looks! I am very happy with how lightweight it is and how easily my skin "drinks" all the moisture in! I highly recommend this product, along with the Glass Skin Serum!
The moisturizer is lightweight, refreshing, and helps to reduce the redness in my cheeks. Perfect for everyday use!
My absolute favorite and go to in my skincare routine. I will never go without this. Use twice daily and it never disappoints
Not my favorite product from Peach and Lily but still highly effective and worth it. I don't like that it feels like it leaves a slightly stickiness that doesn't melt into the skin.

My favorite moisturizer! I'll never be without this now. I am 52 years young. People always think I'm in my 30s. Part of that is just good genes. Part is good skincare. I've taken care of my skin since I was 12. Peach and Lily however, has really helped my aging skin over the past year. It's brightened my skin tone, faded some dark spots taken out the redness, and just quenched my thirsty skin. I love the glass skin line most. I have people ask what I'm using and telling me they hope they age like me.

This moisturizer is lightweight in that it does not feel heavy, but DEEPLY moisturizing, providing an instant glow! I use this in the mornings before applying makeup/skin tints and I never need to use a primer with it! Fungal acne safe!

avis.titre: It feels so good on my skin!
avis.texte: I love this moisturizer. It feels so good on my skin, and it doesn't leave a greasy or oily residue. It literally makes my skin glow. I had only been using the system I bought for 5 days before someone commented on how bright and glowy my skin was :)

This moisturizer is the final step of my morning routine and has helped my skin so much that I quit using makeup primer and just use this moisturizer as my primer. It's so hydrating and absorbs nicely.
Feels cooling and relaxing to the skin. It's a light moisturizer that is effective in relieving dryness and irritation.

avis.titre: Favorite lightweight moisturizer for the summer
avis.texte: I live in an incredibly humid climate, and this moisturizer has been my go-to for summer! I went through about 2-3 bottles so far and don't plan on switching anytime soon. Peach and Lily has been a lifesaver for my sensitive acne-prone skin.

avis.titre: Good moisturizer for my sensitive skin.
avis.texte: The only CON about this moisturizer is that it is pretty sticky/ tacky while patting it onto the face to absorb as it starts dries. My skin is pretty sensitive so it starts to hurt when it starts getting tacky. If it wasn't so sticky, I would love it more. Overall, I still do like this moisturizer. It hasn't gave me bad rash or broke me out badly. I like that it's fragrance free and silicone free. I never really cared about the ingredients of skin products before and just used whatever. However, I have become more aware of the things I use as my skin condition has started to change since I've reached my 30's. I will buy this again.
This formula is still tried and true. I live by it. It works as advertised.

I wanted to like this so much. But it is so sticky no matter what i do. I have combination skin, but cant use anything with oil in it or I break out. But this did nothing to hydrate my skin. It claims to hydrate without leaving skin sticky- but it did the exact opposite for me.

I love the whole glass skin line. My 52 year old skin has never looked better! I used to struggle with redness, enlarged pores, and dark spots. I still have a bit of redness occasionally, but very little. My dark spots are there, but much lighter now. My skin is much more hydrated now. Peach & Lily glass skin collection plus their matcha pudding cream are my go to for daily skincare habits. These products deliver results! Shipping is always quick and items are packaged well.
The best moisturizer to lock in serums. Lightweight but hydrating and not at all shiny. Perfect for convo acne prone skin.
Perfect lightweight moisturizer, great for summer and doesn't clog pores at all! Fragrance free, really makes me love my glass skin in progress!
PEACH & LILY Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer Is a god send. It is so light weight and adsorbs quickly into your skin with no sticky feel

avis.titre: My biggest regret was not trying out this sooner
avis.texte: I have oily skin and I regret not trying this moisturizer sooner. It provides the skin with hydration without the feeling of stickiness or oiliness throughout the day. Way better than my Tatcha Water Cream. Will repurchase this one to wear in the AM!
Love this product. It's been so challenging to find a product that works well for my sensitive skin. This is so soothing and gentle.
I love how lightweight and hydrating this gel moisturizer is. I just finished up my first bottle and ordered another!

avis.titre: This moisturizer is giving glass skin
avis.texte: If you're looking for a light-weight gel moisturizer that won't clog your pores and will genuinely soften and keep your skin looking dewy (think glass skin), this is it! I use it every morning and evening in the summer time and it's perfect for oily skin! The ingredients are pure and if I'm feeling I want something more I'll add one drop of castor oil to it and let me tell you, it's the perfect formula! 💕
I love this stuff. Doesn't flare up my skin and sometimes I'll wear it on its own when I'm in a hurry. Shockingly very moisturizing for a gel, water based moisturizer

My absolute favorite moisturizer. It really helped to clear my skin snd reduce the appearance of my acne scars. Even my dermatologist complimented my skin after I started using it. I honestly just need it in a bigger bottle. It has a very nice light gel texture.
Added to my daily skincare routine! Leaves the skin so glowy but not sticky. Love!
I was dealing with breakouts and uneven skin tone. I started using Peach Lily and my skin is so much healthier, and clear!
This gel moisturizer is lightweight and feels refreshing. It doesn't leave a sticky film on the skin, and gives a natural glow. Definitely a keeper !

An amazing moisturizer. It's incredibly lightweight and it feels refreshing. I do prefer the Matcha Pudding, but I often switch with this one during summer cause my face tends to be more oily, and it helps me so much !

It used to be my favorite moisturizer before I tried the Matcha Pudding. Incredibly lightweight on the skin, gives the skin an instant glow and boost of hydration. Will definitely repurchase, it's perfect for summer !

avis.titre: Best moisturizer for me that I've ever used
avis.texte: I have had oily or combination skin my whole life. Never used moisturizer before, since my face looks very youthful and most moisturizing products made me break out. I older now, and need moisturizer-this is the best product ever!
I love layering this product for extra glow and glass skin look. It's also a great product prep to smooth my skin for my more thick hydrating moisturizers I need to use. Love it!
Even my husband noticed a difference! I have been using the Glass Skin Moisturizer every day for two weeks. My skin looks bright, the texture is improving, and it hasn't caused any breakouts.
I have really enjoyed using this moisturizer. It feels so weightless on my skin!

It really does leave your skin looking like glass! And no oil buildup throughout day. I breakout using just about anything on my face, I have not broken out once in 6 months using this brands glass skin line.
I breakout from just about anything, I have not broken out once using this for about 5 months. And it really does make your skin look like glass!
Like this non greasy moisturizer. Great for makeup to go on top too! I also use as a hand cream
I absolutely love this stuff! It truly has transformed my skin! I was on the phone face timing and my friend said omg your skin looks so shiny like glass!!!!!

This is my favorite hydrator of all time. The formula is perfect, it's so so hydrating and still gives you that glass skin. For a simplified day routine, I use this + sunscreen. I always get the most compliments on my skin from this!
Love but I feel there is little product when I pump it out, this doesn't really matter ig but personal preference how the product is made with the pump but the product inside is great

avis.titre: Hydrates and leaves a nice glow
avis.texte: This is another peach and Lilly product that I love because it hydrates my skin without irritating it. My skin has become more sensitive with age and a lot of ingredients in moisturizers have been irritating my skin the last few years. I have noticed my skin has a nice glow to it when I use the moisturizer with the glass skin serum, the products work great together!
Great morning moisturizer to use under makeup. It's part of my regular routine!
I'm so happy I finally found a moisturizer for my sensitive skin. It reacts to everything but this, and while it's not the most occlusive, it hydrates my skin and gives it a glow
I breakouts easily and this is perfect as it does not clog pores!
I love this it's really light on my skin it pumps out like gel but feels like water but not cold it feel really good and it gives me a beautiful glow all day

avis.titre: My Favorite Peach and Lily Moisturizer
avis.texte: Even though Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer has a lightweight texture, it's formula is as hydrating as many heavy weight moisturizers have. It doesn't give me shine and works perfectly in summer. It's not enough for winter, but I still layer it with one more product on top.

Light, moisturizing serum with no unpleasant odor. Sinks into my skin well. Only been using it for 2 weeks so I haven't see a lot of difference in my skin, but the moisturizing is lovely and I'll keep on with it.
I have dry skin and this gel leaves my skin very hydrated and smooth, I see a 100% positive change in my face. I will continue buying it when I need more.
This is the 4th moisturizer from P&L and I'd say its the lightest one. Ideal for humid climate. It's great for anyone who doesnt feel sticky
My skin can get oily in warm weather so I needed something to replace the matcha moisturizer on humid days. This stuff is perfect for that!

avis.titre: Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer Perfect for Oily/Combinatio
avis.texte: The Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer is one of the few moisturizers I can use that won't clog my pores. It's light, soaks right into my skin and leave me with that dewy, glass-skin glow. A must for my sometimes oily/combination skin.
It's a great lightweight moisturizer, I will probably save it for spring and summer. I need something a little heavier in the winter

Heard some good reviews about it and I also happened to try their cleanser once and I liked it so I decided to give this a try and after a few days of using I BROKE OUT so bad. All around my face and under chin. My money just went to waste. SO DISAPPOINTED
I use this in conjunction with a regular heavy moisturizer in the winter. I layer it with the Glass Skin Serum and Veil Mist. This regiment has transformed my skin.
It really makes my skin look like glass! Would love to try the mist also
I love this moisturizer. It is so lightweight yeah it is so moisturizing and it has the hyaluronic acid in it which definitely plump up the skin. I will order this again.

I love that this facial moisturizer is a clear, scentless gel that absorbs quickly and hydrates. Also love the ease of the pump dispenser. Looks clear so I hope all the benefits are packed into it bc it looks like clear gel- which I like.

I am 62yrs old with oily/combo skin and just started with P&L. I was looking for a new vegan skin care routine and stumbled across P&L! I began with the glass skin discovery set and loved everything about it, but my type of skin was eh with the matcha pudding moisturizer. I ordered the water gel moisturizer and WOW my skin loves and absorbs the gel moisturizer so much better!!! The consistency and coolness feel of the gel is magnificent and I will never use another moisturizer or skin care product line again! The matcha pudding moisturizer does not go to waste though, it's creamy texture and moisturizing is amazing on my body:) Thank you P&L!
THIS WATER GEL MOISTURIZER WAS IINTRODUCED TO ME BY MY DAUGHTER. IT IS SO LIGHT,, YOU DON'T NEED MUCH AND IT ABSORBS INTO THE SKIN SO NICE. I LOVE IT!!!
As other reviewers said it causes little white pumps on my t zone area and it doesn't do anything.

I have oily/sensitive to breaking out skin and this didn't make me break out, even when using it with any if the P&L serums, toners, or mists. It feels nice putting on, and it feels like it spreads out into water when I put it on my face. Two pumps goes a long way and I can spread it across my face and neck easily!
This product is very moisturizing I have been using this for 2 weeks and it's amazing

avis.titre: Perfect for oily skin and layering products
avis.texte: It is perfect to wear under sunscreen or on top of other products and won't make you oily
Excellent product. Very lightweight. Moisturizes without a heavy feel

avis.titre: This is my go to moisturi
avis.texte: This is my go to moisturizer as well and it has been so good to my oily combination skin

not a bad moisturizer but not the greatest either. its great for warmer weather since its lightweight and doesnt make your skin greasy. the moisture doesnt last all day through the colder weather though.

not a bad moisturizer but not the greatest either. its great for warmer weather since its lightweight and doesnt make your skin greasy. the moisture doesnt last all day through the colder weather though.

avis.titre: Bad reaction, difficult return process still not completed.
avis.texte: So my skin reacted to both glass skin products I ordered (really unusual intense redness where I applied). I initiated the return process the week I received the items, but many weeks later I still don't have "permission" to return, nor the return address etc. It's also not a no questions asked situation. I have emailed three times, two of the three got no response, the third person had questions for me. It's not an automated thing so it's not easy to make sure to check the boxes to get an authorization to return. Anyway it's been almost a month and I still am not able to return. Not really worth so much of my time and effort, I'll stick to suppliers I know with easy returns when one is (rarely) needed.

I enjoyed using this product. It is lightweight and I love how it is water-based. The best part is that it comes in a travel size making it convenient to take on the go. It gives just the right amount of moisture without making the skin look or feel oily. I highly recommend this product to others.
I love using this product. It's perfectly moisturizing and not too heavy.
I'm usually not a fan of gel moisturizers, but after using the toner and the serum, this moisturizer was great as part of a 4 step process. Not too heavy.
this moisturizer is truly a holy grail product for me. it's light on my skin and doesn't clog my pores like some cream based moisturizers do. love!!

avis.titre: It wasn't as hydrating as I would like it to be
avis.texte: I was looking for a hydrating moisturizer that would not leave my skin looking oily but I'm still seeing some dryness around my problem areas
So glad I got the travel size because this doesn't give glass skin look
I love how light the actually product feels. Although instantly can feel the hydration, I do feel that the hydration doesn't last as long

avis.titre: Works great and a perfect size for travel!
avis.texte: I love that I can put this in my liquids bag, and leave it there for many trips as you do not need a lot. Moisturizers and works well with other products! Will continue to purchase for travel.
I love this line of skincare. I have noticed really nice improvements in my skin's texture and appearance. Really happy I gave this brand a try.
I've tried several different moisturizers, and the glass skin water-gel is absolutely amazing. The product makes my face feeling refreshed and so soft. I highly recommend this product.
I never have acne except when i get my period but i bought this and started having acne.
Perfect for the summer months on my combo skin. I like to pair it with the glass skin serum for extra hydration.

avis.titre: Lovely texture, but not moisturizing enough
avis.texte: I would have loved this in my 20s and maybe 30s, but it is way too light for my more mature skin. On the plus side, it is a dream to apply. I love the gel texture and it sinks quickly into the skin. On the down side, it just isn't moisturizing enough. I feel like I need to reapply again. There are better options for me.
This serum is the best. Gives your skin a healthy glow, feels great and leaves it hydrated.

avis.titre: Been my fav for almost 2 years now
avis.texte: I swear I've tried so many different moisturizers and my skin is kind of combination, this leaves my sling soft but not oily!
I have combination skin and I'm 58...this works great. It's clean too.

I am 31 and I have extremely oily/ acne prone skin. I have never been able to find a moisturizer that didnt break me out until I found this one. I use it every morning and night and it has never broken me out. If you let it properly dry it it will not be sticky. I can apply makeuo over it easily.

I placed an order at peach and Lily, I had this moisturizer in my cart but deleted it and added the Matcha one. After I ordered I guess it never refreshed and it ordered this one. I emailed the second after and didn't get a response until the next day. I've loved my other moisturizer but not a huge fan of this one. And I also have the serum so it feels like I have two of the same product.
It's a great product but if you have acne prone severely oily skin it'll cause pimples for sure
